h1: Custom Etched Candles for Corporate Events
metaDescription: Order custom etched candles for corporate gifts. Perfect for branding with a subtle, elegant touch. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Etched candles offer a refined way to display your logo or message without the bulk of a printed label. The design is permanently carved into the wax, creating a sophisticated look that works well for corporate gifts, event favors, or hospitality amenities. Choose from pillar or votive shapes in classic white or cream wax for a clean, professional appearance.
heroAltText: Custom etched candles with corporate logo carved into white wax, displayed on a table
